personality_one_liner: A sleek, refined, and minimalist digital learning workspace with elegant slate surfaces, razor-sharp borders, soft ambient elevation, and distraction-free typography.

spacing.rule: Clean, structured spacing with disciplined rhythm. Micro-spacing (4-8px) for internal groupings, 16px for card padding, 24px for major sections.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind.
Use on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use as a frosted overlay on the Featured Course hero card over an abstract colored background.
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows or form inputs.
Do not over-blur; maintain readability by applying a translucent tint layer behind text.

screens.name: Login/Register
screens.purpose: A welcoming, zero-friction entry point that gets students excited to start.

states.error: Standard alert toast with Retry CTA

screens.layout: Top half: A friendly illustration or abstract shapes background with the LearnSpace logo. Bottom half: Form container wrapping inputs. Inputs use Pill radius (999) with subtle surfaceTertiary backgrounds. Large, chunky brandPrimary Continue button sticky at bottom. Include a 'Sign in with Google' secondary pill button.

screens.name: Student Dashboard
screens.purpose: The student's main hub: highlights what's next and celebrates recent progress.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero card and horizontal scroll list.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty desk with 'Ready to start your first course?' and a 'Browse Courses' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: 'Continue Learning' hero card. The card features an abstract colorful background image with a glassmorphism overlay, showing the current module, a bold circular progress ring, and a play icon CTA. Middle: Gamification section (Streaks, Badges) displayed as chunky 2-column grid cards. Bottom: Horizontal scroll list of 'Subjects' (Math, Science), each card having a tinted icon container (brandTertiary) and subject title.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: A clean, functional overview of platform health and quick operational actions.
screens.layout: Top: 2x2 grid of metric cards (Total Students, Active Courses, Revenue, Completion Rate) using surfaceSecondary cards with large text scales. Middle: 'Recent Activity' vertical list (e.g., New Registrations, Support Tickets) with functional icons. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Manage Content' for rapid access.

screens.name: Course Detail Placeholder
screens.purpose: The structured learning flow from pre-test to post-test for a specific subject.

states.empty: Illustration of an open book with 'No modules unlocked yet'.

screens.layout: Top: Edge-to-edge hero image (e.g., Biology flasks) with a mandatory gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) at the bottom for Course Title readability. Content: A vertical timeline or list of modules (Pre-Test, Materials, Videos, Manual Book, Discussion, Post-Test, Results). Each row uses a tinted icon container. Locked modules look visually distinct (muted opacity).

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: A space for the student to view their identity, settings, and accumulated achievements.
screens.layout: Top: brandSecondary colored banner with the student's avatar (real image or initials in a circle) overlapping the bottom edge. Middle: 'Achievements' horizontal scroll of earned badges. Bottom: Settings list rows. Each row has a brandTertiary tinted icon container, a title, and a chevron on the right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Tactile/Playful personality strictly: rounded corners (lg to pill), friendly spacing, and absolutely NO BLUE or INDIGO anywhere (even in defaults).
Use Fredoka for display fonts and Nunito for text. Ensure Expo loads these correctly.
For the 'Continue Learning' hero card on the Student Dashboard, layer it as follows: abstract colorful image -> glassmorphism overlay -> text and UI elements. This makes it look premium but playful.
On the Course Detail placeholder, ensure the hero image has a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Make interactive elements feel chunky and touchable with shadow tier 2.
Admin Dashboard should still follow the Tactile language (rounded cards, coral/yellow accents), but with denser, metric-focused layouts.
Always wrap scrollable screens with a sticky CTA container at the bottom when a primary action is needed, accounting for safe areas.
Use Phosphor filled icons everywhere to maintain the chunky, friendly aesthetic.
Ensure 'brandTertiary' (#FDE6E2) is used as the background for icon containers, with 'onBrandTertiary' (#D94A38) for the icon color itself.
